title: Exploring the mechanism of Heidihuang Pill in the treatment of osteoporosis based on network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation.
authors: Tian, Zenghui; Cui, Kaiying; Tian, Yuxiao; Chen, Yungang; Liu, Guoyan; Zhang, Farong; Hao, Yanke; Li, Yingying
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学、分子对接和实验验证探索黑地黄丸治疗骨质疏松的机制，虽涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Currently, anti-osteoporosis (OP) treatment imposes a certain economic burden on patients and society; therefore, studies have focused on exploring anti-OP therapies. As a classic prescription in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), the Heidihuang Pill (HP) was clinically shown to alleviate OP. However, the mechanism behind its effect remains unclear. We aimed to determine this mechanism using methods such as network pharmacology and experimental verification. METHODS: Network pharmacology was used to identify the active ingredients, targets, and mechanisms of action of HP in treating OP. Molecular docking technology was then used to verify the interactions between the active ingredients and target proteins. Finally, an OP rat model was established through in vivo experiments to validate the results obtained from network pharmacology. RESULTS: Overall, 178 targets were retrieved, which are key targets of HP for treating OP. Protein-Protein Interaction network analysis showed that RAC-alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase (Akt1) (degree =132) was the most reliable target of HP for treating OP. Gene Ontology functional analysis revealed that the regulation of HP on OP mainly occurs as follows: it mainly manifests as a response to hormones in biological processes; it mainly acts on membrane rafts in cellular components; and it mainly involves the binding of transcription factors in molecular functions. Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes pathway enrichment analysis indicated that the Advanced Glycation End products/Receptor for Advanced Glycation End products (AGE-RAGE) signaling pathway in diabetic complications and the hypoxia-inducible factor (HIF)-1 signaling pathway are the main pathways involved in the HP treatment of OP. Molecular docking results showed that Akt1 has a good binding ability with peoniflorin, with a binding energy of -56.66 kcal/mol. In vivo experiments confirmed that the trabecular bone mineral density, trabecular number, and bone volume fraction of model rats treated with HP significantly increased (P < 0.05 vs. the model group). Histopathological staining showed that the number and morphology of the trabecular bones improved (vs. the model group). Additionally, the expression of HIF-1 signaling protein in rat bone tissue increased, while the expression of AGE/RAGE signaling protein decreased (P < 0.05, vs. the model group). CONCLUSION: Peoniflorin, the main active ingredient in HP, acts on Akt1 and treats OP through the AGE-RAGE and HIF-1 signaling pathways. This study showed the precise molecular pathways and core therapeutic targets of HP in treating OP, and provides a scientific basis and new research direction for treating OP with TCM.
abstract_zh: 背景：目前，抗骨质疏松（OP）治疗给患者和社会带来了一定的经济负担；因此，研究聚焦于探索抗OP疗法。作为中医（TCM）中的经典方剂，六味地黄丸（HP）在临床上被证明可缓解OP。然而，其作用机制仍不清楚。我们旨在通过网络药理学和实验验证等方法确定这一机制。方法：采用网络药理学方法鉴定HP治疗OP的活性成分、靶点及作用机制。随后利用分子对接技术验证活性成分与靶蛋白之间的相互作用。最后，通过体内实验建立OP大鼠模型，以验证网络药理学获得的结果。结果：共检索到178个靶点，这些是HP治疗OP的关键靶点。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析显示，RAC-α丝氨酸/苏氨酸蛋白激酶（Akt1）（度=132）是HP治疗OP最可靠的靶点。基因本体功能分析显示，HP对OP的调节主要表现如下：在生物过程中主要表现为对激素的反应；在细胞组分中主要作用于膜筏；在分子功能中主要涉及转录因子的结合。京都基因与基因组百科全书通路富集分析表明，糖尿病并发症中的晚期糖基化终末产物/晚期糖基化终末产物受体（AGE-RAGE）信号通路和缺氧诱导因子（HIF）-1信号通路是HP治疗OP的主要通路。分子对接结果显示，Akt1与芍药苷具有良好的结合能力，结合能为-56.66 kcal/mol。体内实验证实，经HP处理的模型大鼠的骨小梁骨密度、骨小梁数量和骨体积分数显著增加（与模型组相比，P < 0.05）。组织病理学染色显示，骨小梁的数量和形态得到改善（与模型组相比）。此外，大鼠骨组织中HIF-1信号蛋白的表达增加，而AGE/RAGE信号蛋白的表达降低（与模型组相比，P < 0.05）。结论：HP中的主要活性成分芍药苷作用于Akt1，并通过AGE-RAGE和HIF-1信号通路治疗OP。本研究展示了HP治疗OP的精确分子通路和核心治疗靶点，为中医治疗OP提供了科学依据和新的研究方向。
